basic_info.description: Stylish 2 story remodeled home in "Parkside" just off Sunset Blvd. Turn-key home has upgrades throughout: kitchen has granite counters with stainles appliances incl. stainless sink, added skylight & recessed lighting. Oak hardwoods & recessed & tract lighting throughout on dimmers. Dining area adjacent to kitchen has added skylights on switches. Living room has gas fireplace insert for added home heating. 2 bedrooms on main floor both have french doors which open to expansive trex deck overlooking a manicured yard with patio/garden. 2-bedrooms 1-bath on main level & 1-bedroom & bath on lower level next to expansive laundry room with added storage cabinets. Finished tandem garage with plenty of lighting added. Newer windows,upgraded electrical & copper plumbing with house bolted to foundation.
